design: Exploratory continuation; recorded after baseline/schema review and before new calculations, not preregistered. Prior expansion findings are known.

hypotheses.question: Does repeated question wording track repeated answer-gist wording within the available one-practitioner digest corpus?
hypotheses.calculation: Independently normalized question/answer TF-IDF on all949candidates; all distinct-upload pairs and .40+question-neighbor subset; Spearman across upload-pair means to reduce unequal pair weighting; source-balanced and exact-question strata.
hypotheses.falsifier: Prompt-neighbor answer similarity fails to exceed a fixed-seed size-matched cross-upload reference, or association disappears/reverses after removing pairs from conservative source families.
hypotheses.bounds: Lexical co-resemblance in AI summaries; no question equivalence or answer agreement inference.

hypotheses.question: Could source-neighbor families contaminate an upload-level model split, and are lexical neighborhoods stable to threshold choices?
hypotheses.calculation: Connected components of cross-upload question cosine edges at .40/.50/.60/.70/.80/.90; report isolated candidates and largest-component support. Group uploads conservatively when at least two question-pairs cosine>=.80 link them; sensitivity .70/.90. Exact repeated question strings audited separately.
hypotheses.falsifier: No multi-upload components or conservative links; a model split passes leakage check if no strict>=.80family spans partitions.
hypotheses.bounds: Grouping is a quarantine policy, not verified recording reuse, semantic communities or true contamination proof.

hypotheses.question: How much matched caption/title pair resemblance covaries with upload length and caption word-count differences?
hypotheses.calculation: Identical25matcheduploads; compare raw Spearman and residual rank association after controlling absolute log duration ratio and caption-word-count ratio; within-minus-between residual separation and leave-one-publisher-out influence; report dependent pair units.
hypotheses.falsifier: Residual title-caption rank association is negligible/opposite, or publisher separation disappears after nuisance controls; results remain descriptive.
hypotheses.bounds: Conditioning is a diagnostic, not causal mediation, speaker separation or domain encoder validation.

hypotheses.question: Do actual closed-book, retrieval-augmented and LoRA runs improve held-out source-grounded response metrics without leakage?
hypotheses.calculation: Audit executed model receipts, fixed grouped train/evaluation splits, source-family overlaps and retrieval scope; display actual measured metrics with their scoring definition only when runs complete.
hypotheses.falsifier: No improvement, unchanged results, failed run, or source-family leakage invalidates a generalization claim.
hypotheses.bounds: Source-digest reconstruction metrics are not truth, speaker, extraterrestrial-origin or human-preference validation.

implementationNote.benchmarkGuard: The model worker independently specified a stronger quarantine rule before this worker executed it: any exact normalized question OR any pair cosine>=.80 OR at least three pairs>=.40. The planned two-link .70/.80/.90 rule remains a separate sensitivity. Neither is original-session truth.
implementationNote.source: Direct model-worker task message; analysis independently reconstructed the rule and confirmed its 55 source groups.
implementationNote.thresholdInterpretation: These thresholds are exploratory operational choices. No held-out semantic-performance optimum or preregistration is claimed.

round11Amendment.reason: The first changed candidate shows selected-pool contrast: quarantine is constructed from question similarity, so answer-similarity contrasts must expose prompt-similarity support.

commonSupportDesign.binConvention: Left closed, right open; final upper bound includes exact1.0.
commonSupportDesign.eligibleBins: Retain only bins containing at least one within-quarantine and one cross-quarantine neighbor pair. Empty strata remain null and are not assigned zero similarity.
commonSupportDesign.weights: Pooled number of neighbor pairs in each shared-support bin divided by total neighbor pairs in all shared-support bins; apply identical weights to within/cross means.
commonSupportDesign.alternateDescription: Also report original pooled means and the two unweighted common-support group means; these are different estimands and do not replace the original first-candidate numbers.
commonSupportDesign.falsifier: A positive same-quarantine lexical advantage is disconfirmed in this diagnostic if its standardized mean is no greater than the standardized cross-quarantine mean.
commonSupportDesign.scope: Coarse prompt-similarity standardization addresses one selected-pool composition issue, not causal source reuse, speaker identity or answer agreement. Pair dependency and remaining within-bin variation persist.
